title: 第23章 三年之期 求推荐求月票第24章 八年潜修 上 求推荐求月票
content_zh:
楚无忌回到洞府时，天色已暮，丹峰外云气沉沉。
他抬手掐诀，指尖青光流转，淡青光纹如涟漪般一圈圈荡开，洞府禁制无声而启，石门无声滑入洞壁。
禁制之内，数道传音符如萤火般悬浮，微微闪烁。
其中大多来自同门道贺，陆景承、蔡昆等人皆有问候，恭贺他成功筑基。
楚无忌神色平静，一一回信，言辞不卑不亢，滴水不漏。
只是当目光扫过最后几道传音符，仍未见到那道预料中的灵光时，他眉头微不可察地皱了一下，心中那股若有若无的期待终究落空，泛起一丝淡淡的郁闷。
他盘膝坐下，调息良久，才将心绪平复。
一月之前，他闭关前最后一件事，便是依门规写了拜帖，遣人送往灵鹫峰。
那拜帖言辞极尽恭谨，只道“筑基初成，愿聆师训”，未敢奢求指点，亦未提半分机缘。
然而拜帖递上之后，灵鹫峰一直无半点回音。
一日、十日、一月……时光流转，依旧寂静如常。
楚无忌虽心性沉稳，深知师尊玄澜真人乃青玄门唯二结丹修士之一，更是结丹后期之人，为求修为突破到假婴境界，以追逐那一丝虚无缥缈的元婴机缘，常年闭关不出实属正常。
但轮到自己身上，发出去的消息如泥牛入海，一两个月都没有回复，难免心绪难平，有点郁闷。
无奈之下，只得继续闭关苦修，打磨法力。
又过一月，期间洪玄易等人曾来访，取了灵髓液分成。
三人虽与楚无忌有同门之谊，但身处这随时遮蔽动静、威能难测的大阵之中，终究如坐针毡，颇不自在。
他们婉拒了楚无忌交流心得之请，只留下一份以灵髓液为主药的上古养元类丹药的丹方，灵髓玉液丹，便取了分成匆匆离去。可惜此丹的多味辅药早已灭绝，只有一丁点参考价值。
第三个月末，洞府仍旧清净。
这日，他正打坐运功，忽听洞府外三声轻叩。
叩声不重，却夹着一缕极细的灵力波动，顺着禁制缝隙探了进来。禁制并未预警，显然来人所持之物，正是他先前在禁制上预留过通行印记的几种宗门凭信之一。

楚无忌睁开眼，抬手一拂，石门开了一线。
门外站着一名执事弟子，练气九层，神态恭谨，双手捧着一枚传讯玉符，手里还握着执事堂传令符。
“楚师叔，灵鹫峰传讯，玄澜真人召见。”
楚无忌接过玉符，指尖灵力一触，玉符中便传来一道淡淡的声音：
“半个时辰内，来灵鹫峰玄鹫观。”
寥寥一句。
楚无忌面上却不露分毫，只淡淡点头：“知道了。”
执事弟子行礼退下，石门再次合拢。
楚无忌站在原地片刻，才缓缓走到石台前，取出一只玉匣。
匣中整齐摆着十粒鱼龙丹，丹纹隐现，香气内敛，皆是他此前炼得的成丹。
他换上一身筑基长老的青色法袍，将玉匣郑重收入储物袋最深处，又顺手点了点风波元潮阵阵盘，确认洞府无虞，这才收敛灵光，踏出洞府，径直往灵鹫峰而去。
......
灵鹫峰常年云雾缭绕，越近峰顶，寒意越重。
石阶九曲，崖风从石缝穿过，刮在脸上生疼。
玄鹫观前，两名身着鹫纹道袍的童子立于正门旁的寒松之下，扫过楚无忌腰间令牌与传音玉符，确认无误，才微微躬身。
“楚师兄，真人目前就在观内等你。”
楚无忌不多言，跟着童子入内。
观中灯光幽暗，越往里走，灵压越沉，像是整座山峰的灵气都被人拢在此观之中。
玄鹫观临崖而建，正殿极小，内里仅有一蒲团、一香炉、一面无框古镜。
蒲团上，一道人背对而坐，身形清瘦，衣袍素淡，却给人一种稳如泰山的厚重之感。

那份灵压，绝非筑基修士可伪装，乃是结丹后期修士多年凝炼法力、神识如海方能具备的威压。
楚无忌上前，规规矩矩地行礼。
“弟子楚无忌，拜见玄澜师尊。”
content_en:
When Chu Wuji returned to the cave, it was already dusk and the clouds were heavy outside the Dan Peak.
He raised his hand to make the secret, and the green light flowed on his fingertips. The light green light patterns spread out in circles like ripples. The cave's restrictions were silently opened, and the stone door slid silently into the cave wall.
Within the restriction, several transmission notes floated like fireflies, flickering slightly.
Most of them came from fellow disciples to congratulate him. Lu Jingcheng, Cai Kun and others all sent greetings and congratulated him on his successful foundation building.
Chu Wuji looked calm and replied to each letter one by one. His words were neither humble nor arrogant, and he was flawless.
But when he glanced at the last few transmission notes and still didn't see the expected spiritual light, he frowned slightly, and the vague expectation in his heart finally failed, and there was a hint of depression.
He sat cross-legged and adjusted his breath for a long time before calming down.
One month ago, the last thing he did before going into seclusion was to write a greeting note according to the sect's rules and send someone to Lingjiu Peak.
The words of the greeting card were extremely respectful, saying only, "The foundation has just been established, and I am willing to listen to the teacher's teachings." He did not dare to ask for advice, nor did he mention any chance.
However, after the invitation was submitted, there was no response from Lingjiu Peak.
One day, ten days, one month... As time goes by, it remains silent as usual.
Although Chu Wuji has a calm mind, he knows that Master Xuanlan is one of the only two alchemy monks in Qingxuan Sect, and he is in the late stage of alchemy. In order to pursue his cultivation and break through to the false infant realm, in order to pursue the illusory opportunity of the Nascent Soul, it is normal for him to stay in seclusion all year round.
But when it was my turn, the messages I sent out were like mud and water, and there was no reply for a month or two. It was inevitable that I would feel uneasy and a little depressed.
In desperation, he had no choice but to continue practicing hard in seclusion and polishing his magic power.
Another month passed, during which Hong Xuanyi and others came to visit and took a portion of the spiritual marrow liquid.
Although the three of them were from the same sect as Chu Wuji, they still felt like they were sitting on pins and needles and felt quite uncomfortable in this large formation that could block movement and movement at any time and whose power was unpredictable.
They declined Chu Wuji's request to share their experiences, leaving only a prescription for an ancient nourishing elixir with spiritual marrow liquid as the main medicine, the spiritual marrow jade liquid pill, and then took their share and left in a hurry. It is a pity that the multi-flavored auxiliary medicines of this elixir have long been extinct and have only a little reference value.
At the end of the third month, the cave is still pure.
On this day, while he was meditating and doing his exercises, he suddenly heard three gentle knocks from outside the cave.
The knocking sound was not loud, but there was a very fine wave of spiritual power that penetrated through the gap in the restriction. There was no warning in the ban, and it was obvious that what the visitor was holding was one of several sect credentials that he had previously reserved a pass mark on the ban.
Chu Wuji opened his eyes, raised his hand and flicked the stone door open.
Standing outside the door was a deacon disciple who was at the ninth level of Qi training with a respectful expression. He was holding a jade messenger talisman in both hands and the deacon hall messenger talisman in his hand.
"Uncle Chu, Lingjiu Peak sent a message and Master Xuanlan summoned him."
Chu Wuji took the jade talisman, and with a touch of spiritual power on his fingertips, a faint voice came from the jade talisman:
"In half an hour, come to Lingjiu Peak Xuanjiu Temple."
Just one sentence.
Chu Wuji didn't show anything on his face, he just nodded lightly: "I understand."
The deacon disciple bowed and left, and the stone door closed again.
Chu Wuji stood there for a moment, then slowly walked to the stone platform and took out a jade box.
There are ten fish dragon pills neatly placed in the box. The pill patterns are looming and the fragrance is restrained. They are all pills he has refined before.
He put on the blue robe of the Foundation Establishment Elder, solemnly put the jade box into the deepest part of his storage bag, and tapped the Fengbo Yuanchao array disk to confirm that the cave was safe. Then he gathered his aura, stepped out of the cave, and headed straight for Lingjiu Peak.
...
Lingjiu Peak is shrouded in clouds and mist all year round, and the closer you get to the top, the colder it gets.
The stone steps are curved, and the cliff wind passes through the cracks in the stones, causing pain on the face.
In front of the Xuanjiu Temple, two boys wearing eagle-patterned Taoist robes stood under the cold pines next to the main entrance. They scanned the token and sound transmission jade talisman around Chu Wuji's waist to confirm that they were correct, and then bowed slightly.
"Senior Brother Chu, the real person is waiting for you in the temple."
Chu Wuji said nothing and followedThe boy enters.
The lights in the temple are dim. The further you go inside, the deeper the spiritual pressure becomes. It's like the spiritual energy of the entire mountain is being gathered in this temple.
Xuanjiu Temple is built on the cliff. The main hall is very small, with only a futon, an incense burner and a frameless ancient mirror inside.
On the futon, a man sat with his back facing each other. He was thin and his clothes were plain, but he gave people a sense of stability and weight.
That kind of spiritual pressure cannot be faked by foundation-building monks. It is the kind of pressure that only monks in the late stage of pill formation can possess after years of condensing their magic power and their spiritual consciousness like the sea.
Chu Wuji stepped forward and saluted politely.
"Disciple Chu Wuji, pay homage to Master Xuanlan."
